calls.name: level-1 distance
calls.note: The frozen continuous surface: the geodesic distance of the c = 1 ball between the lifted residual and the lifted codeword. The statements are the frozen specification's, verbatim; the argument names follow the callable's own signature.

coupling.note: The behaviour enters the cost the assignment is taken over: the offset beta*R_c*(1 - |rho_i - s_k|) is subtracted from the distance, and moving rho_i moves the cost. A row scalar alone could not change an argmin; this term varies over the codewords, which is why it can.

excluded.surface: the level-1 index k1 = argmax_k P_ik
excluded.reason: an argmax is discrete and carries no gradient

excluded.surface: the straight-through estimator one_hot(k1) + P - P.detach()
excluded.reason: its backward is the identity on P by construction, not the derivative of its forward value

excluded.surface: the cohesion statistic and its mid-rank
excluded.reason: rho_i is a frozen buffer computed from the training split once before training; it is not a differentiable function of any input
measured once from the epoch-0 chosen distances and frozen; a constant of the run, not of the graph
